en: The postcard features a colorized photograph of a war memorial (Kriegerdenkmal) with a statue of a soldier holding a flag, mounted on a stone pedestal with reliefs and medallions. The monument is set against a background of trees. The left bottom of the image includes the words 'Kriegerdenkmal.' The upper right part of the postcard has the printed phrase 'Gruss aus Bad Pyrmont.' There is also a publisher's mark on the left edge.
